question: India has been ranked _________ in the Medical Tourism Index (MTI) for 2020-21 out of 46 destinations by the Medical Tourism Association.
solution:
The correct answer is __**10th.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**Medical Tourism Index (MTI):-**

__
 
• It is a biannual ranking of international healthcare destinations based on American perceptions.
 
• It is developed by the International Healthcare Research Center (IHRC) and is based on a survey of over 2,000 Americans.
 
• The MTI ranks countries on a scale of 1 to 100, with a higher score indicating a more attractive medical tourism destination.
 
• India has been ranked **10th** in the **Medical Tourism Index (MTI) **for **2020-21 out of 46 **destinations by the Medical Tourism Association.
 
• The following are the reasons why India is ranked 10th: 
 
 
• India offers **world-class medical facilities** and highly skilled doctors at affordable prices.
 
• The country has a **well-developed healthcare infrastructure **with advanced technology and modern equipment.
 
• India is also known for its traditional and alternative forms of medicine such as** Ayurveda, Yoga, and Naturopathy.**
 
• The government has also taken initiatives to promote **medical tourism** in the country by easing visa rules and providing incentives to medical tourists. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Informatio__**

 
• If India was ranked 15th, it would still be a** decent ranking** considering the number of destinations on the list. 
 
• If India was ranked 20th, it would be a** lower ranking** and may indicate that the country needs to improve its** medical tourism facilities** and services.
 
• If India was ranked 5th, it would be a **higher ranking** and would indicate that the country is a top destination for medical tourism.
